baselineNote: All 158 unique frame names match; 151 normalized declarations changed, 7 same. Shared variables and document fonts changed, so same declaration does not mean same render. Supersedes design.pen/main comparison.

rendering.command: pen interactive --in cezarion.pen --out .ai/design-reference/iteration-2/rendering-audit.pen; execute Export(topLevelIds, "png", outputDirectory, {scale:2}) in sequential batches
rendering.systemFontInstallation: Not needed: captured responses prove the renderer loaded the requested families from its built-in Google Fonts catalogue. No system font changes made.
rendering.disposableProbe: Only a separate unsaved pen.dev session received one added specimen frame (E4RdR); exported to ../font-audit/E4RdR.png. No source node edits, font substitutions, or probe content in reference exports.
rendering.referenceStatus: Faithful source renders with known renderer glyph fallback defects; NOT defect-free.

fonts.documentEntriesAre: URL references, not embedded font binaries; Inter Variable is not the UI variable

icons.stroke: Exact renderer output is filled glyph outlines with no SVG stroke. Preserve viewBox/path rather than guessing stroke width. Material Symbols circle is a thin hollow ring.

renderDefects.cause: Poppins cmap and loaded Noto fallback cmap lack glyph; successful font loads do not repair fallback selection.
renderDefects.appGuidance: Use explicit glyph fallback with proven coverage, or the corresponding mapped icon. Do not reproduce tofu boxes.
